verdict.rationale: Exporting your own data from an online government tax account is a fair question for this kind of service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any data export, download of account records, open-format output, or data-portability or exit path. The evidence covers only registration, sign-up, online account management and the Making Tax Digital software channel.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
